title: SAML: Negotiation Prober & Validation Playbook for Interactive Setup
creator: Avery Chen
description: Build an interactive negotiation prober and playbook that runs during the SAML 2.0 setup wizard to validate metadata, certificate rotation scenarios, assertion shape compatibility, and provide deterministic remediation steps. This task covers the prober engine, UI signals for admins, audit-enriched events for postmortems, and a small rules engine with heuristics that score compatibility mismatches (entityID normalization, binding mismatch, missing NameID formats, cert chain expiry). The prober will attempt a safe, non-destructive metadata exchange, sample an assertion using a test-binding (when IdP allows), and fall back to syntactic validation + historical heuristics where an assertion probe is impossible.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive wizard surface shows a negotiator step that reports: metadata syntax OK, required bindings present, cert expiry window, and compatibility score (0-100)
Prober can optionally do a live assertion probe when IdP supports HTTP-POST/Artifact and produce a sampled assertion with PII redaction
All prober outcomes produce structured audit events (action=prober_run, result={ok,warning,failure}, details=tokenized-list) stored in audit logs for 365 days
Admin UX surfaces clear remediation steps (copyable commands, suggested IdP config changes) and links to a reproducible troubleshooting gist
Score thresholds map to deterministic rollout gates: score>=80 allow autoprovide certificate pin; 50-79 recommend manual review; <50 block auto-provision and require support intervention
Unit + integration tests cover schema diffs, cert parsing edge cases (expired, long chain, unsupported alg), and retry/backoff for flaky IdPs
implementation_notes: Prober will reuse the existing metadata parser from ENG-71200 but add a schema-diff stage that flags ignored elements
Heuristics engine is intentionally small (rules + weights) so it is auditable and can be surfaced in the UI — avoid ML here
When performing live probes, only run against an allow-list of admin-provided endpoints; abort if IP or org mismatch to reduce security risk
Audit events must include request_id, prober_version, and a non-reversible redaction hash of sampled assertion to allow correlating without leaking PII
RBAC v2: only users with 'admin:onboard:sso' can run a live probe; others see read-only diagnostics
test_plan: Synthetic IdP harness in CI that simulates: valid metadata, missing binding, expired cert, chain-of-trust mismatch, and live assertion flow
Manual runbook test with partner IdP (staging) to exercise assertion sampling and verify audit event enrichment
E2E in staging: wizard flow with feature-flag enabled for 50 internal customers; collect telemetry for false-positive rate of heuristics
Security review checklist: threat model for live probes, allowed endpoint validation, redaction verification, and KMS use for any secrets
updates: 2026-02-22: Spike completed. Implemented a PoC prober that parses metadata and returns a compatibility score using 8 heuristic rules (see PoC gist). Found an edge case with duplicate KeyDescriptors — added rule to prefer 'signing' usage when present.
2026-03-02: UX sync with Design. Decided to show only headline compatibility and an 'expand' view for full rule breakdown. Design requested 'copy remediation' CTA for each rule.
2026-03-05: Security review kickoff. Early notes: require admin allow-list for live probes; redact assertion attributes in logs; consent banner in UI before sampling assertions.
2026-03-09: Integrated audit event schema v2. Logged events in 'sso.prober' stream. Verified retention policy 365d in Audit config.

2026-03-12: QA found flaky behavior when an IdP returns multipart metadata. Added a normalization step and a retry with exponential backoff. Filed follow-up ENG-78901 for deeper multipart parser hardening.
comments: Priya Patel (2026-02-23): I want the heuristics to be reversible/transparent — record rule weights in the audit event so Support can explain a score to customers.
Avery Chen (2026-03-03): Agree — storing weights as metadata (not PII) is fine. Will add to event schema as 'rule_breakdown'.
Jordan Lee (Security, 2026-03-06): Live assertion sampling needs opt-in with explicit admin consent. Also suggest rate-limiting probes per org to avoid DoS on IdP endpoints.
Marta Ruiz (Design, 2026-03-02): Provided initial wireframes. CX asks for simple language for remediation steps — avoid SAML jargon in the top-level summary.
Devops (2026-03-10): Please ensure prober does not trigger external egress during CI runs. Use the synthetic harness.
review_feedback: PM review (Leah Gomez, 2026-03-01): Prioritize clear opt-out flows. For enterprise customers with strict compliance, provide an offline validation artifact they can share with their IdP team.
Security review (Jordan Lee, 2026-03-08): Blocker mitigations required for live probes: enforce allow-list and add a proof-of-possession header signed by KMS key.

Engineering review (Samir Gupta, 2026-03-11): Implementation approach is fine; prefer a feature flag behind 'sso_prober_v1' and incremental rollout. Suggest limiting live probes to internal-only until telemetry is stable.
